content.value: Convert the following statements into propositional logic and use model checking to (17) [CO2] prove that Macavity is responsible for the crime:

“Either cat fur or dog fur was found at the scene of the crime. If dog fur was found, officer Thompson had an allergy attack. If cat fur was found, then Macavity is responsible for the crime. Officer Thompson did not have an allergy attack."
